status: PROPOSED — pending operator decision (see ledger flag LF-06). Thresholds were fixed in this file BEFORE any live window existed. Currently 0 strategies are LIVE, so 0 demotions have been triggered.
scope: Only a strategy whose status is LIVE can be demoted. PAPER and BLOCKED strategies are not touched by this gate. Re-promotion is never automatic.

applicability.note: G7 (calibration, expected calibration error <= 0.10) applies to every product that emits a probability: moneyline and joint-event parlays. Margin, total and prop outputs are not probabilities, so G7 is not applicable to them. A gate that is applicable but not True (including null) is a FAIL. The G7 wording is taken from origination/scripts/model_w10.py.

minimum_live_window_games.note: Copied from the G3 sample-size gate in origination/results/validation-w10.json (>= 80 games singles, >= 40 pairs parlays, >= 100 player-games props).

rules.name: Provenance failure
rules.trigger: G1 is not True on the live window
rules.basis: Project rule. Only official nfl.com rows may evidence a live strategy (G1).

rules.name: Market dependence
rules.trigger: G8 is not True (strategy needs sportsbook prices)
rules.basis: No official source publishes sportsbook prices (ledger/data/price-probe.json). A market-dependent strategy cannot be settled or evidenced, so it cannot stay LIVE.

rules.name: Applicable gate not passed (fail-closed)
rules.trigger: any gate in the product's applicable list is not True; null counts as FAIL
rules.basis: Project rule. Family-wise error control reference: NIST e-Handbook 7.4.7.3 (Bonferroni's method). That page covers Bonferroni, not Holm; Holm is a step-down refinement of the same family-wise idea and is cited as the project's method, not as NIST's.

rules.name: No evidence window or too small
rules.trigger: live window missing, or n below minimum_live_window_games for the product
rules.threshold: n >= 80 singles | 40 parlay pairs | 100 prop player-games
rules.basis: A strategy that cannot show a sample at least as large as its G3 gate cannot stay LIVE. Confidence-interval reference: NIST e-Handbook 7.1.4 (What are confidence intervals?).

rules.name: Skill lower bound below zero
rules.basis: Project rule using the same lower-bound quantity that ranks the leaderboard.

rules.name: Multiplicity-adjusted significance lost
rules.basis: Same alpha as gate G5 in origination/results/validation-w10.json.

rules.name: Instability across halves
rules.trigger: either half of the live window has mean loss difference >= 0
rules.basis: Project rule matching gate G6 (both halves must improve).

rules.name: Stale official settlement
rules.trigger: more than 14 days since the last official result was added to the feed
rules.basis: Project rule. A strategy whose results are not being verified cannot be shown to be current.

rules.name: Re-promotion (not a demotion)
rules.trigger: a PAPER strategy wants to become LIVE
rules.threshold: passes every rule above on a NEW out-of-sample window AND operator sign-off recorded in requirements/data/suggestions.json
rules.basis: Project rule. Prevents a single lucky window from re-promoting a demoted strategy.

unresolved_before_adoption: The operator has not yet approved the thresholds (D4 minimum sizes and D8 14-day window are proposals).
No official odds source exists, so D2 can only ever be applied to a licensed feed that the operator chooses (see ledger flag LF-01).
Live-window statistics are not produced by any current pipeline; the gate is therefore inert until one exists.
